messages:
Priya: Following up on the postmortem 170011 - we need owners, timelines, and a lightweight verification plan for GPU capacity fixes. Proposed split: quota uplift, scheduler tuning, headroom + alerts. Owners: Evan (quota), Nora (scheduler), Suresh (headroom).

Evan: OK. I'll open the quota request today and include cost impact. If cloud lead time is long, Ops-Lead you mentioned a burst pool option?

Ops-Lead: Yes, we have a short-duration burst pool we can allocate for up to 7 days per request. I'll check current usage and approvals; will reply by EOD.

Nora: For scheduler tuning I want a small test matrix: adjust preemption threshold, backfill window, and bin-packing aggressiveness. Canary on staging at 10% traffic first.

Suresh: Headroom proposal: minimum static GPUs per region + dynamic cushion based on p95 usage. Add alert when sustained load >85% headroom for 10m. Also I'll add a scheduled smoke test (2x synthetic for 1h) after rollout.

Priya: Timeline proposal: T0 (today) - tickets + audit; +72h - owners present concrete plan & staging test matrix; Sprint 1 (2w) - staging canaries + alerts + quota initial; Sprint 2 (wks3-4) - rollout + regression check.

SRE-Bot: Action items RB-3412 created and linked to incident 2280011000. Reminder: 72h checkpoint scheduled.

Evan: Ticket created: https://tickets.internal/INC-5601 assigned to cloud-quotas, cost center noted.

Nora: Pushed scheduler test PR: https://git.internal/sched/tests/PR-14. Canary config in the PR.

Suresh: Headroom doc draft: https://docs.internal/headroom/draft-2. Adding dashboard panels and alert rules today.

Priya: Meet tomorrow 10:30 for 20m to confirm staging matrix and owners. If anyone cannot attend, post updates here. :calendar: :thumbsup:

Ops-Lead: I'll attend and bring reserved pool numbers.

Priya: Minor risk note: recurring pattern of surge spikes. Post-rollout we must run monthly regression tests for 3 months. Add to ops cadence.

Evan: Agreed. Marking my "open quota ticket" done.

SRE-Bot: Reminder set: 2280014400 "GPU capacity 72h checkpoint" by Priya.
